User.title: User
User.description: Registered readers in the Wilting of Words literary archives

email.description: Unique email address of the reader

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of last sign in

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Community reader reflections and guestbook reviews visible across all devices in real time

location.description: City or geographical location of the reader

message.description: Reflective review or note on the book

pageNumber.description: Optional manuscript page number the reader was viewing when reviewing

ReaderProgress.title: ReaderProgress
ReaderProgress.description: Synced reading progress, bookmarks, and page highlights for a registered reader

currentPage.description: The page number the reader last reached

bookmarks.description: List of page numbers bookmarked by the reader

highlights.description: List of serialized highlights with pages, colors, and notes

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last progress update

SponsorScratch.title: SponsorScratch
SponsorScratch.description: Persistent scratch-to-reveal state for the premium sponsor card for a specific authenticated reader

sponsorScratchRevealed.description: True if this reader has scratched and revealed the sponsor card

revealedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the card was revealed

userId.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the reader

/users/{userId}.description: Collection of registered readers mapped by their sanitized email or user id

/users/{userId}/progress/state.description: The active, synced reading progress state document for a reader

/users/{userId}/sponsor/scratch.description: Per-user persistent state of the premium sponsor scratch-card reveal

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Public community reader reflections and guestbook entries synced across all devices
